C0631.title: Tmall Cracks Down on Duplicate Product Listings
C0631.summary: In July 2024, media reports described Tmall's adjustment to its spam-information rules and renewed enforcement against duplicate listings. Merchants selling two or more identical items in a store must keep the earliest-published listing and delete the rest. Merchants operating multiple stores with the same products must cancel brand authorization for duplicate stores and delete the products. Violators may face warnings, product delisting or deletion, operating restrictions and fines depending on severity.
